summary: Add payload-free outbox backlog and explicit replay commands to the operator CLI
details: Use evydence outbox backlog and evydence outbox replay over the existing instance-admin endpoints, retaining server-side authorization and the atomic replay audit/idempotency transaction.

Require an explicit job and reusable operation key for replay; reject duplicate flags and malformed inputs before network access, and resolve captured configuration/private credentials through the existing typed pipeline.
Print only validated count/replay fields, hide server diagnostic bodies, reject redirects and bound requests to 30 seconds while preserving cancellation identity.
Keep help independent of credential resolution and update the canonical worker-outbox reference and generated CLI configuration bindings.

compatibility.notes: New opt-in online CLI commands; existing routes, SQL, SDK and evidence formats are unchanged. Explicit instance:admin authority remains required. Replay keys are not generated or retried automatically. Existing signal-based worker drain remains the lifecycle interface.

security: The CLI remains an authenticated client of existing focused operator services. Closed response projections exclude payloads and raw errors; redirects cannot forward operator credentials. Private-file conflicts, input validation and context cancellation retain the existing configuration boundary.
limitations: Remaining deployment/runbook work and required full-ticket closure gates remain pending in incomplete EVY-1206. Local command tests do not verify a deployed operator credential or live provider.
